_comment: Level-1 replay (13.2): scenarios whose steps need no terminal (stdin lines, EOF, stdout waits, exit). `cargo nextest run -p hoocode-code-main` replays them against hoocode and checks tests/snapshots/. The default-bundle print scenarios (print-tool-read/-bash/-edit/-search/-multi/-todo-write/-context-files/-read-paging) join once their L2 passes (12.4 SearchHooCode).

session._comment: Entry ids are random; remapped to <id-N> by first appearance so the parent links are still compared. Timestamps are wall clock; parentSession (clone/fork) is a path with a random session file name.
